generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all applicable taxes, levies, duties and cess, building worker welfare cess (if applicable) etc., as per the latest GOK and Government of India prevailing as on the date of NIT.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Any reputed individual/Company having valid KPWD contractor registration certificate of Class IV & above are eligible for participation in the tender for which supporting documents shall be uploaded and are eligible for participation for which scanned copy of the same shall be uploaded.

technicalCriterionList.description: I/we shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by KPCL or by any State Government/Government of India/ Union Territory. I/we declares that EMD has not been forfeited and None of my contracts have been terminated/foreclosed on account of default in KPCL or elsewhere during the past 3 (Three) years. My/our offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. I/we have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. I/we shall pay fair and reasonable wages, which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by GOK to the labours/workmen employed in the contract. I/we have accepted the condition that KPCL reserves the right to foreclose the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason.

I/We hereby declare that I/we have carefully studied and understood the nature, scope, importance, urgency, and requirements of the work. I/We have personally inspected the site and familiarized myself/ourselves with the site conditions and all relevant aspects of the work. I/We undertake to take all necessary precautions and adopt appropriate safety measures during the execution of the work. I/We fully understand the emergency and urgency involved and undertake to commence and complete the work without any further delay, strictly within the stipulated time period, without causing any hindrance or compromising the quality of the work. Having understood all the facts, site conditions, and requirements, I/we hereby quote my/our rates for the satisfactory execution and timely completion of the work. The interested bidders/participants must visit the site and get a site visit letter before 31.10.2026 within15:00 Hrs from Chief Engineer (Civil Design) and has to be uploaded in the tender by the Bidders. Otherwise, Bidders are liable for rejection without assigning any reason.

itemList.description: Removing white or colour wash by scrapping and sand papering and preparing the surface smooth including necessary repairs to scratches etc. complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.

Dismantling tile work in floors and roofs laid in cement mortar including stacking material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge. For thickness of tiles 10 mm to 25 mm - Flooring

Dismantling and removing existing electrical switches, socket outlets, switch plates and associated accessories of any type and rating, including safe isolation of the electrical supply, removal of switch plates, modular switches, socket outlets, mounting frames, boxes and associated accessories wherever required, carefully disconnecting the existing wiring without damaging the concealed conduits or surrounding wall finishes. The work shall include sorting and stacking reusable materials at the designated location, disposal of unserviceable debris, making the exposed wiring safe by properly insulating and securing the wire ends, and making good minor damages to the surrounding surface, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. All work shall be carried out by qualified electrical personnel after ensuring the circuit is de-energised and safe.
